observations.consequence: Unused current operands do not erase the filtering/sorting duties. Later analysis should report missing or incorrect representation/source inputs instead of silently declaring those duties unnecessary.

Dimensions-only and metrics-only operations should seed the named collection; full metadata explicitly preserves the full response. The latter must not be reused as a whole-value demand for every metadata operation.
Pairing, sequence, row counts, save conditions and required write effects are explicit Task boundaries. Empty output or an unused return value does not remove a required action.

Source review should make the source-goal decision explicit; current use alone cannot prove necessity for the analytic result.

Returning a path is the direct save utility contract. A caller that discards that return must not acquire an artificial return-value seed. Required file write/path effects remain separately preserved.
